items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Teddy had a really gorgeous book, with Roy Eldridge, you know, and Chu Berry...

ctx.x: I... I could understand them just playing the Blues all night long. And Teddy Hill had this beautiful book that they were playing, you know. Teddy had a really gorgeous book, with Roy Eldridge, you know, and Chu Berry... He had a nice little band, you know, and he had beautiful arrangements! And most of the guys, you know, the bands in this city had arrangements! Don Redman, Fletcher, Benny Carter. When John Hammond came... I used to say... We used to snicker, you know, say, "Count Basie brought this big…
But that's not saying the men weren't good. They just weren't playing the music that...
